search_window.basis: Since the previous verified hourly Care Line supplementary watch heartbeat; production collection remains authoritative.

coverage_notes.scope: US states, District of Columbia and US territories: concrete hospital/ED/maternity/behavioral-health/dialysis/oncology/primary-care closure or suspension, rural/emergency service loss, ambulance/air-medical/base closure or suspension, official CMS termination/rescission/CLIA action, and effective restoration of a lost essential service.

cms_public_notices.observation: CMS official Public Notices inspected before all targeted searches; newest visible rows remain seven notices dated 2026-10-30. No newer provider termination, rescission, or CLIA action listed.

coverage_notes.search_quality: DEGRADED: 12 queries executed and CMS was accessible, but search responses were predominantly old, international, or otherwise nonresponsive; independent fresh local and territorial recall cannot be established reliably. Relevant Roseland and Bruceton reports concern previously known or earlier events.
coverage_notes.limitations: Bounded supplementary recall, not exhaustive; no qualifying development verified as new within the window. Sunday indexing and poor topical search ranking limit confidence, particularly for rural communities and territories. No-findings does not imply no access change occurred.
coverage_notes.controls: One append-only private heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger. No review approval, public publication, production collector mutation, schedule alteration, or automation disabling.
